links.to_node: prevent my colleague's switch to organic hair products.
I prevent the colleague from switching to organic hair products.
The colleague's salon does not independently adopt organic hair products.
Clients continue to be exposed to less healthy, non-organic hair products.
Clients face the risk of chemical damage and allergic reactions.
The price increase for hairdressing services still occurs due to regulation.
Some regular clients cannot afford the increased prices despite the prevention.
My action delays the colleague's voluntary adoption of healthier products.
